summary: A-UI-01 is corrected in the repaired layout. All fourteen scenes expose the four source-bound project commands. Save Video busy and Open-project guard scenes disable those commands while preserving the relevant context and guard continuation actions. No blocking structural or source-coverage finding remains within this targeted repair review. The repaired UI requires its own exact-subject review.
scope: Targeted upstream verification of restored persistent New/Open/Save Project/Save As controls, their source bindings, busy/guard representation and connected scope/recovery regressions. Prior accepted geometry and unrelated behavior are carried forward without a broad re-review.

screenshotInspection.evidence: All four persistent project commands are visible alongside project identity in each scene, with the active-video identity/save row still separately located.
The restored header persists through track, group, framing and Add-decision states; existing contextual actions and feedback remain represented.
The restored header persists through source crop, clip decisions and video-save failure; project actions remain distinct from saving the active video.

All four project commands visibly show disabled states during Save Video commit and the Open-project guard. The guard retains enabled retry/discard/cancel choices and describes failed save, retained work and pending Open.

correctionChecks.evidence: Actual captures on pages 1–4 show New, Open, Save Project and Save As in the persistent project header of all fourteen scenes. Effective nodes bind project-new to new-project, project-open to open-project, project-save to save-project and project-save-as to save-project-as, with corresponding sourceActionRefs. All four nodes are disabled in s11-video-saving-busy and s12-project-guard-failure. Guard project-retry/save-project, project-discard/discard-project and project-cancel/cancel-transition remain enabled. The separate Save Video control retains save-video.
correctionChecks.impact: Users have visible source-required project entry points, can distinguish project persistence from active-video persistence, and can understand unavailable project actions during the represented commit/guard states without losing the guard's recovery choices.
correctionChecks.specificCorrection: Completed in the exact reviewed layout. Carry this repaired layout into the UI artifact and have its resulting captures reviewed; this structural verdict does not approve an unreviewed UI revision.

connectedSourceChecks.result: The frozen active-export/export-cancellation rule keeps New/Open visible but unavailable and does not initiate a guard, chooser or queue before actual export completion. None of these fourteen fixtures represents active export or cancellation. Their ordinary enabled states therefore do not contradict that rule; no additional export scenario is required by this repair.

Project Save and Save As remain distinct from Save Video. The repaired bindings do not introduce implicit persistence of the current video draft. Static review establishes represented scope and binding, not runtime persistence enforcement.
